headline: Planning Board to review definitive subdivision application for 80 Seventh Avenue.
summary: The board will consider a definitive subdivision application to split the lot at 80 Seventh Avenue into two lots, with one new lot for a single-family home. The board will also approve minutes from its October 5, 2026 meeting.
items: Definitive Subdivision application for 80 Seventh Avenue, 01854, submitted by Michael Brown to split the lot into two, with a new single-family home on the new lot, located in the Traditional Single-Family (TSF) zoning district
location: City Council Chambers, 375 Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852
plain_text:
City of Lowell - Planning Board 
 
Planning Board Agenda 
October 19, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
 
Meetings will be held in the City Council Chambers at 375 Merrimack 
Street, Lowell MA 01852 or via remote participation as permitted by An Act Extending 
Certain COVID-19 Measures Adopted During the State of Emergency signed by Governor 
Healey on 3/28/2025. 
 
The public is welcome and can participate remotely as follows:  
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org or local cable channel 6. Those 
wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item shall register to speak in advance of the 
meeting by sending an email to dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone number to call so that 
you may be issued a Z oom link to the meeting. If no access to email, you may contact 
Development Services at 978 -674-4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the 
day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
        
Review all application documents online at: www.lowellma.gov/1098/Planning-Board 
 
I. Minutes for Approval 
 
10/5/2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
II. Continued Business 
 
 
III. New Business 
 
Definitive Subdivision – 80 Seventh Avenue, 01854 
Michael Brown has applied to the Lowell Planning Board to subdivide the existing lot at 80 Seventh 
Avenue into two lots. The newly created lot will be the site of a new single-family home. The subject 
properties are located in the Traditional Single-Family (TSF) zoning district. The project requires 
Definitive Subdivision approval from the Planning Board under Lowell’s Subdivision of Land 
Regulations.  
 
IV. Other Business 
V. Further Comments from Planning Board Members 
VI. Adjournment
